MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '71837-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv ORDER BY inv.version DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (inv)-[hp:HAS_PART]->(:Part)
WHERE hp.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, sum(hp.qty) AS directQty
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cs:CONTAINS_SET]->(ns:Set)
WITH s, inv, directQty, collect({set: ns, qty: cs.qty}) AS nestedSets
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
WITH s, inv, directQty, nestedSets, collect({fig: mf, qty: cm.qty}) AS nestedFigs
CALL {
  WITH nestedSets
  UNWIND nestedSets AS ns
  WITH ns.set AS ns, ns.qty AS qty
  MATCH (ns)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(ninv:Inventory)
  WITH ns, qty, ninv ORDER BY ninv.version DESC
  WITH ns, qty, collect(ninv)[0] AS ninv
  MATCH p = (ninv)-[:HAS_PART|CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..6]->(leaf)
  WHERE (leaf:Part AND all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) <> 'HAS_PART' OR r.is_spare = false))
     OR (leaf:Set OR leaf:Minifig)
  WITH ns, qty, p, leaf
  WHERE leaf:Part
  WITH ns, qty, reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships(p) | acc * coalesce(r.qty, 1)) AS mult
  RETURN sum(qty * mult) AS nestedSetParts
}
CALL {
  WITH nestedFigs
  UNWIND nestedFigs AS nf
  WITH nf.fig AS mf, nf.qty AS qty
  MATCH (mf)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(minv:Inventory)
  WITH mf, qty, minv ORDER BY minv.version DESC
  WITH mf, qty, collect(minv)[0] AS minv
  MATCH p = (minv)-[:HAS_PART|CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..6]->(leaf)
  WHERE (leaf:Part AND all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) <> 'HAS_PART' OR r.is_spare = false))
     OR (leaf:Set OR leaf:Minifig)
  WITH mf, qty, p, leaf
  WHERE leaf:Part
  WITH mf, qty, reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships(p) | acc * coalesce(r.qty, 1)) AS mult
  RETURN sum(qty * mult) AS nestedFigParts
}
WITH directQty, nestedSetParts, nestedFigParts
WITH directQty, nestedSetParts + nestedFigParts AS nestedQty
WITH directQty, nestedQty, directQty + nestedQty AS totalQty
RETURN round(100.0 * nestedQty / totalQty, 2) AS percentage

    MATCH (mf)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(mf_inv:Inventory)
    WITH mf, mf_inv

    LIMIT 1

MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '10785-1'})
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1

// Direct parts from the set's own inventory (excluding spares)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[hp:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE hp.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, sum(hp.qty) AS direct_qty

// Nested sets and minifigs quantities from the set's own inventory
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cs:CONTAINS_SET]->(nested_set:Set)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty,
     sum(CASE WHEN cs IS NOT NULL THEN cs.qty ELSE 0 END) AS nested_set_qty,
     sum(CASE WHEN cm IS NOT NULL THEN cm.qty ELSE 0 END) AS minifig_qty

// Recursively compute total parts from nested sets and minifigs
// We'll use a recursive approach with variable-length paths
MATCH path = (inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..6]->(item)
WHERE (item:Set OR item:Minifig)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty, path, relationships(path) AS rels
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty,
     reduce(acc = 1, r IN rels | acc * r.qty) AS path_multiplier,
     last(nodes(path)) AS leaf_item

// Get the leaf item's current inventory and its parts
OPTIONAL MATCH (leaf_item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(leaf_inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty, path_multiplier, leaf_inv
ORDER BY leaf_inv.version DESC
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty, path_multiplier, head(collect(leaf_inv)) AS leaf_inv_current

OPTIONAL MATCH (leaf_inv_current)-[hp2:HAS_PART]->(p2:Part)
WHERE hp2.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty, path_multiplier, sum(hp2.qty) AS leaf_parts_qty

WITH s, inv, direct_qty, nested_set_qty, minifig_qty,
     sum(path_multiplier * leaf_parts_qty) AS nested_total_parts

WITH direct_qty, nested_total_parts,
     direct_qty + nested_total_parts AS total_parts
RETURN round(100.0 * nested_total_parts / total_parts, 2) AS percentage

MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '71837-1'})
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1

// Direct parts from the set's own inventory (excluding spares)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[hp:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE hp.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, sum(hp.qty) AS direct_qty

// Get all nested items at any depth with path quantities
MATCH path = (inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..]->(item)
WHERE item:Set OR item:Minifig
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item,
     reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships(path) | acc * r.qty) AS path_qty

// Get the current inventory of each nested item
OPTIONAL MATCH (item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(item_inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_inv
ORDER BY item_inv.version DESC
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, collect(item_inv)[0] AS current_item_inv

// Get direct parts from each nested item's inventory (excluding spares)
OPTIONAL MATCH (current_item_inv)-[hp2:HAS_PART]->(p2:Part)
WHERE hp2.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, sum(hp2.qty) AS item_direct_parts

// Now we need to account for nested items within each nested item recursively
// Get nested items inside each item at any depth
OPTIONAL MATCH (current_item_inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..]->(sub_item)
WHERE sub_item:Set OR sub_item:Minifig
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_direct_parts, sub_item,
     reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships((current_item_inv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*1..]->(sub_item)) | acc * r.qty) AS sub_path_qty

// Get sub_item's current inventory and direct parts
OPTIONAL MATCH (sub_item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(sub_inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_direct_parts, sub_item, sub_path_qty, sub_inv
ORDER BY sub_inv.version DESC
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_direct_parts, sub_item, sub_path_qty, collect(sub_inv)[0] AS current_sub_inv

OPTIONAL MATCH (current_sub_inv)-[hp3:HAS_PART]->(p3:Part)
WHERE hp3.is_spare = false
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_direct_parts, sub_item, sub_path_qty, sum(hp3.qty) AS sub_direct_parts

// Calculate total parts from nested items: 
// For each item: path_qty * (item_direct_parts + sum of sub_path_qty * sub_direct_parts)
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, item, path_qty, item_direct_parts,
     sum(sub_path_qty * sub_direct_parts) AS sub_total_parts
WITH s, inv, direct_qty, 
     sum(path_qty * (item_direct_parts + sub_total_parts)) AS nested_total_parts

// Total parts = direct + nested
WITH direct_qty, nested_total_parts, direct_qty + nested_total_parts AS total_parts

// Percentage from nested sets and minifigs
RETURN round(100.0 * nested_total_parts / total_parts, 2) AS percentage

RETURN part AS part_num
